# Source font provenance

`SourceCodePro-Regular.ttf` is the unmodified Adobe Source Code Pro Regular
font used to generate the Nebo Console raster atlas under the included OFL.

```text
SUPPLIED_PROVENANCE=Adobe Source Code Pro official adobe-fonts/source-code-pro release repository
ORIGINAL_FAMILY=Source Code Pro
ORIGINAL_STYLE=Regular
FONT_VERSION=Version 2.042;hotconv 1.1.0;makeotfexe 2.6.0
SOURCE_FONT_SHA256=74bd80d3e42a08517cd7e1108ba3d86f2da29ac0f3065be95e0357956ab9db37
SOURCE_FONT_SIZE_BYTES=210312
SOURCE_UNITS_PER_EM=1000
LICENSE=SIL Open Font License 1.1
LICENSE_SHA256=7c940e28a5388e9bba866cf0e408edda45fe0899ba98665b8f6ab31dc5e4b8ff
COPYRIGHT=© 2023 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name ‘Source’
```

The complete license supplied with the asset is preserved byte-for-byte in
[`LICENSE.md`](LICENSE.md). The TTF is also preserved byte-for-byte. No network
lookup was used to replace, normalize, or augment either file.

The generated runtime asset is independently identified as
`NeboConsoleMonoAtlas`; it is documented as derived from Source Code Pro
Regular and is not named with the Reserved Font Name. Adobe does not endorse
Nebo or the derived atlas.
